## 1. Learner Background & Gap Analysis Profile

This is a general topic checklist for the **Jerry Heuer MAA-NCS Team Contest**, not a verified profile of the reader. Adjust it to your own coursework and the problems you miss in practice.

Because the Heuer competition is targeted at undergraduates across all four years, problems assume mature problem-solving heuristics in topics that rarely receive dedicated coverage in standard introductory calculus sequences.
